metadata_schema.name: limit_up_day
metadata_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE limit_up_day (
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    trade_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    sealed_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sealed_count >= 0),
    broken_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (broken_count >= 0),
    down_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (down_count >= 0),
    touched_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (touched_count = sealed_count + broken_count),
    content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    raw_pages BLOB NOT NULL,
    parser_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (source, scope, trade_date)
) WITHOUT ROWID

metadata_schema.name: ths_focus_day
metadata_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ths_focus_day (
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    trade_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    raw_pages BLOB NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (source, scope, trade_date)
) WITHOUT ROWID

metadata_schema.name: ths_theme_tab_day
metadata_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ths_theme_tab_day (
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    trade_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    tab_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    tab_rank INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stock_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    usable INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (source, scope, trade_date, tab_name)
) WITHOUT ROWID

metadata_schema.name: ths_theme_tab_stock
metadata_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ths_theme_tab_stock (
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    trade_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    tab_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    tab_rank INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stock_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    stock_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    market_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    abnormal_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    detail_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    usable INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (source, scope, trade_date, tab_name, stock_code)
) WITHOUT ROWID
